title: launch_bound for LOW_OCCUPANCY
rationale_md:
The compiler used more registers than the occupancy target allows, so fewer CTAs are
resident per SM and there is not enough memory-level parallelism to saturate DRAM.
`__launch_bounds__(256, 8)` forces the register budget down to 32/thread.

title: persistent_cta for SMALL_PROBLEM
rationale_md:
The grid is smaller than the device, so wave quantization and launch ramp dominate. A
persistent kernel with one CTA per SM removes both.

title: discharge the open proof obligations
rationale_md: The variant's proof is not `VERIFIED`; the profile cannot be trusted for further optimisation until the open goals are closed. Obligations: Latest proof status is `UNSUPPORTED`; open goals: ['UNSUPPORTED: the model reasons about bit patterns and exact integer arithmetic; dtype `f32` needs IEEE rounding, which is outside its numerical scope (see numerical_scope).'].
